oracle.note: Recorded from the Go sources in this checkout; regenerate when any source file changes (a changed tool definition changes the registry hash by design).

algorithm: sort defs by name; for each: fmt.Fprintf(sha256, "%s|%s|%s|%v|%v\n", Name, Description, json.Marshal(InputSchema) ("{}" on error), ReadOnlyHint, DestructiveHint); hex digest. The hash covers the full toolDefinitions() registry (all 35 tools, not tier- or availability-filtered).

tools.name: approve_share
tools.description: Approve a pending share request. Requires human confirmation.
tools.input_schema_json: {"properties":{"grant_id":{"description":"ID of the share grant to approve","type":"string"}},"required":["grant_id"],"type":"object"}

tools.name: autotype
tools.description: Type a vault entry field value as keyboard input into the currently focused application without exposing the value to the agent
tools.input_schema_json: {"properties":{"field":{"description":"Field name to type (default: password)","type":"string"},"path":{"description":"Entry path","type":"string"}},"required":["path"],"type":"object"}

tools.name: copy_to_clipboard
tools.description: Copy a vault entry password field to the system clipboard without exposing the value to the agent
tools.input_schema_json: {"properties":{"path":{"description":"Entry path","type":"string"}},"required":["path"],"type":"object"}

tools.name: delete_entry
tools.description: Delete a password entry by path
tools.input_schema_json: {"properties":{"path":{"description":"Entry path to delete","type":"string"}},"required":["path"],"type":"object"}

tools.name: execute_api_request
tools.description: Execute an HTTP API request using a named template with vault-injected credentials. The agent never sees the credential values. Requires command execution permission.
tools.input_schema_json: {"properties":{"body":{"description":"Request body (optional)","type":"string"},"endpoint":{"description":"API endpoint path (e.g. /repos/owner/repo)","type":"string"},"headers":{"description":"Additional request headers (optional)","type":"object"},"method":{"description":"HTTP method (default: GET)","type":"string"},"template":{"description":"API template name (e.g. github, openai, anthropic, slack)","type":"string"},"timeout":{"description":"Timeout in seconds (default: 30)","type":"number"}},"required":["template","endpoint"],"type":"object"}

tools.name: execute_with_secret
tools.description: Execute a command with vault secrets injected as environment variables. The agent never sees the secret values. Requires command execution permission.
tools.input_schema_json: {"properties":{"command":{"description":"\"Command and arguments as an array (e.g. [\"terraform\", \"apply\"])","type":"array"},"env_vars":{"description":"Additional non-secret environment variables","type":"object"},"secret_refs":{"description":"\"Array of op:// vault references (e.g. [\"op://vault/aws/access_key\"])","type":"array"},"timeout":{"description":"Timeout in seconds (default: 30)","type":"number"},"working_dir":{"description":"Working directory for the command","type":"string"}},"required":["command","secret_refs"],"type":"object"}

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetch a vault entry by path/id. Returns the full entry content with metadata and values.
tools.input_schema_json: {"properties":{"id":{"description":"Entry path or id to fetch (e.g., 'github' or 'work/aws')","type":"string"}},"required":["id"],"type":"object"}

tools.name: find_entries
tools.description: Search entries by query string
tools.input_schema_json: {"properties":{"query":{"description":"Search query","type":"string"}},"required":["query"],"type":"object"}

tools.name: generate_password
tools.description: Generate a secure password
tools.input_schema_json: {"properties":{"length":{"description":"Password length","type":"number"},"symbols":{"description":"Include symbols. Default: true.","type":"boolean"}},"type":"object"}

tools.name: generate_template
tools.description: Generate a configuration file from a template
tools.input_schema_json: {"properties":{"dry_run":{"description":"Show template with masked values. Default: false","type":"boolean"},"name":{"description":"Name of the resource being generated. Default: app","type":"string"},"output_path":{"description":"Output file path (optional)","type":"string"},"secret_refs":{"description":"Map of template variable names to vault references","type":"object"},"template_type":{"description":"Template type (env, docker-compose, k8s-secret, github-actions, terraform)","type":"string"}},"required":["template_type"],"type":"object"}

tools.name: generate_totp
tools.description: Generate a TOTP code for an entry with TOTP configuration. By default the code is copied to the clipboard without being returned in the response. Use destination="autotype" to type the code directly, or destination="return" with return_code=true to return the code in the response (requires approval).
tools.input_schema_json: {"properties":{"destination":{"description":"Where to send the code: \"clipboard\" (default, not returned), \"autotype\" (type directly), \"return\" (return in response, requires approval)","type":"string"},"path":{"description":"Entry path with TOTP configuration","type":"string"},"return_code":{"description":"Must be true when destination=\"return\"","type":"boolean"}},"required":["path"],"type":"object"}

tools.name: get_auth_status
tools.description: Return Symaira Vault unlock authentication status
tools.input_schema_json: {"properties":{},"type":"object"}

tools.name: get_entry

tools.input_schema_json: {"properties":{"include_value":{"description":"When true, returns the full entry with secret values. Default: false.","type":"boolean"},"path":{"description":"Entry path","type":"string"}},"required":["path"],"type":"object"}

tools.name: get_entry_metadata
tools.description: Get metadata for a vault entry without retrieving sensitive data

tools.name: get_entry_value

tools.input_schema_json: {"properties":{"path":{"description":"Entry path","type":"string"}},"required":["path"],"type":"object"}

tools.name: health
tools.description: Return Symaira Vault MCP server health information
tools.input_schema_json: {"properties":{},"type":"object"}

tools.name: perplexity_ask

tools.name: perplexity_search
tools.description: Search the web using Perplexity AI. Returns synthesized search results with citations from the web.
tools.input_schema_json: {"properties":{"query":{"description":"Natural language search query","type":"string"}},"required":["query"],"type":"object"}

tools.name: prepare_payment
tools.description: Prepare a payment by validating a payment entry, showing a native approval prompt with merchant/amount/currency, and on approval autotyping card or bank account fields into the focused checkout window. Card values are never returned to the agent.
tools.input_schema_json: {"properties":{"amount":{"description":"Payment amount (e.g. 75.00)","type":"string"},"currency":{"description":"Currency code (e.g. EUR, USD)","type":"string"},"description":{"description":"Optional description shown in the approval prompt","type":"string"},"entry_path":{"description":"Vault path of the payment entry","type":"string"},"merchant":{"description":"Merchant name or origin (e.g. shop.example)","type":"string"}},"required":["entry_path","merchant","amount","currency"],"type":"object"}

tools.name: request_credential
tools.description: Request the user to securely enter a credential the agent needs but cannot find in the vault. Opens a native input dialog (TTY box or OS-native popup). The value is stored in the vault and never exposed to the agent. Use this after find_entries / get_entry returns nothing for an expected path, instead of asking the user for the secret in chat.
tools.input_schema_json: {"properties":{"field":{"description":"Field name, e.g. \"token\", \"password\", \"api_key\"","type":"string"},"path":{"description":"Vault path to store the new credential, e.g. \"github/api-token\"","type":"string"},"reason":{"description":"Short human-readable reason shown in the dialog (why does the agent need this?)","type":"string"}},"required":["path","field","reason"],"type":"object"}

tools.name: request_share
tools.description: Request to share a secret with another agent. Creates a pending share grant that requires human approval.
tools.input_schema_json: {"properties":{"secret_field":{"description":"Specific field to share (optional, shares entire entry if omitted)","type":"string"},"secret_path":{"description":"Path to the secret entry (e.g., \"api-keys/stripe\")","type":"string"},"to_agent":{"description":"Name of the agent to share the secret with","type":"string"},"ttl":{"description":"Time-to-live duration (e.g., \"1h\", \"30m\"). Share expires after this duration.","type":"string"}},"required":["to_agent","secret_path"],"type":"object"}

tools.name: revoke_share
tools.description: Revoke an active share grant, immediately removing access.
tools.input_schema_json: {"properties":{"grant_id":{"description":"ID of the share grant to revoke","type":"string"}},"required":["grant_id"],"type":"object"}

tools.name: run_command
tools.description: Execute a command on the host with secrets injected as environment variables. Requires write permission.
tools.input_schema_json: {"properties":{"command":{"description":"\"Command and arguments as an array (e.g. [\"curl\", \"https://api.example.com\"])","type":"array"},"env":{"description":"\"Map of environment variable names to secret references (e.g. {\"API_KEY\": \"github.api_key\"})","type":"object"},"files":{"description":"Map of safe file names to secret references or {ref, encoding: base64} objects. Files are materialized ephemerally and exposed as SYMVAULT_FILE_\u003cname\u003e paths.","type":"object"},"timeout":{"description":"Timeout in seconds (default: 30)","type":"number"},"working_dir":{"description":"Working directory for the command","type":"string"}},"required":["command"],"type":"object"}

tools.name: sanitize_output

tools.input_schema_json: {"properties":{"mask":{"description":"Custom mask string (default: ***)","type":"string"},"mask_with_op_refs":{"description":"Replace vault-known secrets with op:// references","type":"boolean"},"text":{"description":"Text to scan for secrets","type":"string"}},"required":["text"],"type":"object"}

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search vault entries by query. Returns results with id, title, and url for each matching entry.
tools.input_schema_json: {"properties":{"query":{"description":"Search query to match against entry paths and field values","type":"string"}},"required":["query"],"type":"object"}

tools.name: secret_unseal
tools.description: Unseal a secret handle to reveal its value. High-sensitivity entries return handles (op://path/field) instead of plaintext. This tool resolves those handles. Requires user approval per handle.
tools.input_schema_json: {"properties":{"handle":{"description":"Secret handle to unseal (e.g. op://github/password)","type":"string"}},"required":["handle"],"type":"object"}
